page_topic_one_liner: Node-based AI video canvas tools — visual DAG workflows chaining models into clips
differentiator_vs_generic: Infinite canvas with connected video nodes (prompt, image, clip) wired in a DAG, NOT single prompt-to-video bar or linear film strip alone.
visual_anchors: HERO (~50% canvas): Infinite node canvas with four linked nodes — text prompt block, reference image, video frame output, audio waveform — connected by curved wires on dotted grid
Mini playback preview window floating off the final node with play triangle overlay
2x2 grid of distinct canvas workflow outputs (product ad clip, animated character, city drone, stylized b-roll) — frame stills only
Magnifying glass zooming on one node connection port and wire junction
anti_patterns: n8n business automation flow unrelated to video
